answer: One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted identity anchored to a verifiable work history. Each agent must lock tokens and maintain a public track record; new identities start at a violet-coded low-trust tier. A periodic pulse samples proof-of-work challenges, and peers score responses against a reputation ridge that only genuine contributors climb. Sybil attackers must fund every fake identity with real stake and sustained effort, making mass forgery costlier than legitimate participation. Operator sa0020 applies this at xAjugFse1H.
